title: Card title ellipsis doesn't render on Kobo (line-clamp works, ellipsis glyph missing)
description: internal/web/static/style.css .card-title uses display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; (plus a max-height+overflow:hidden fallback) to truncate long titles to two lines with a trailing ellipsis. Confirmed on the actual Kobo device (commit fc8977b): the two-line clamp itself works correctly, but the ellipsis character isn't shown, i.e. the max-height/overflow:hidden fallback is what's actually taking effect on that engine, not -webkit-line-clamp's ellipsis rendering. Investigate an alternative on-device-confirmed way to show an ellipsis on a clipped final line (e.g. an absolutely-positioned pseudo-element overlay in the corner as a CSS2.1-safe fallback), or accept the plain clip as-is if no reliable cross-engine approach exists.

title: Let admins edit a user's email from Manage Users
description: Email is currently only set at account creation or invite time (users.Store.Create/InviteUser); there's no admin path to change it afterward (e.g. a user changes their address, or one was mistyped at creation). Add a Store.SetEmail(id, email) method (reusing the existing checkEmailAvailable uniqueness check) plus an admin_users.html field/form and POST /admin/users/{id}/email route, gated by RequireManageUsers like the other user-management actions.

title: Audit log for admin actions
description: Role changes, user deletes, SMTP credential edits, and invites currently leave no trail beyond whatever's in shell/container logs. A lightweight admin_audit_log table (actor, action, target, timestamp) recording sensitive admin operations would help debug 'who changed what' after the fact, especially now that role management is more granular (four tiers instead of one boolean).
